Simple table with header

```typescript title="WebAssembly"

function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr></tbody></table>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
